responsibility: Contains the grammar and semantic actions used to generate pass C, the aggregate/designator-constant resolution parse in gm2. This pass reparses constant forms with error recovery and invokes `PCSymBuild` to build constant expression trees, resolve constructor and attribute types, and check import visibility relevant to constant evaluation, separate from both detailed declaration construction and executable quad emission.
same_name_distinction: This is the generated grammar and semantic-action implementation for pass C constant-resolution parsing; unlike PCBuild.def, which only declares CompilationUnit, it contains the parser rules that invoke PCSymBuild and related constant-construction actions.
